title: Academy of Technology
text: Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude. In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement. The total fee payable at the time of admission for regular students is ₹1,05,200. The total fee payable at the time of admission for students allotted through TFW is ₹53,200. The tuition fee per semester is ₹52,000. Yes, there are additional fees charged by the University, which include: 1) University Development Fees @ ₹550 per year (one-time payment of ₹2,200) 2) University Registration Fees @ ₹500 (one-time payment) Yes, the caution deposit of ₹10,000 is refundable. The fees can be paid by cash or demand draft in favour of 'ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY,' payable at Kolkata. Yes, the tuition fees may be revised based on directives from the West Bengal Government. Vidyarthi Mediclaim is a medical insurance for students, and it costs ₹2,500 (one-time payment). The library fees, which cover the Book Bank, Journals, and Digital Library, amount to ₹6,000 (one-time payment). sections.heading: | ABOUT SPDY :
sections.text: Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude.

sections.heading: | ABOUT SPDY :
sections.text: In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement.

sections.heading: What is the total fee payable at the time of admission for regular students?
sections.text: The total fee payable at the time of admission for regular students is ₹1,05,200.

sections.heading: What is the total fee payable at the time of admission for students allotted through TFW (Tuition Fee Waiver) scheme?
sections.text: The total fee payable at the time of admission for students allotted through TFW is ₹53,200.

sections.heading: How much is the tuition fee per semester?
sections.text: The tuition fee per semester is ₹52,000.

sections.heading: Are there any additional fees that might be charged by the University (MAKAUT)?
sections.text: Yes, there are additional fees charged by the University, which include: 1) University Development Fees @ ₹550 per year (one-time payment of ₹2,200) 2) University Registration Fees @ ₹500 (one-time payment)

sections.heading: Is the caution deposit refundable?
sections.text: Yes, the caution deposit of ₹10,000 is refundable.

sections.heading: How can the fees be paid?
sections.text: The fees can be paid by cash or demand draft in favour of 'ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY,' payable at Kolkata.

sections.heading: Are the tuition fees subject to change?
sections.text: Yes, the tuition fees may be revised based on directives from the West Bengal Government.

sections.heading: What is the Vidyarthi Mediclaim, and how much does it cost?
sections.text: Vidyarthi Mediclaim is a medical insurance for students, and it costs ₹2,500 (one-time payment).

sections.heading: What are the fees for library services?
sections.text: The library fees, which cover the Book Bank, Journals, and Digital Library, amount to ₹6,000 (one-time payment).

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

text: Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle All academic programmes are approved by AICTE, recognized by Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal (formerly West Bengal University of Technology) . Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude. In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement. sections.text: All academic programmes are approved by AICTE, recognized by Department of Higher Education, Government of West Bengal and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal (formerly West Bengal University of Technology) .

sections.heading: | ABOUT SPDY :
sections.text: Established in 2007, Academy of Technology is one of the most acclaimed self-financed engineering colleges in Karnataka. It has been established by SPDY Educational Development & Charitable Organisation (SPDYEDCO), a trust known for its deep sense of social commitment and dedicated to the promotion of education by inculcating appropriate ethics and attitude.

sections.heading: | ABOUT SPDY :
sections.text: In a metamorphosis of over 18 years, Academy of Technology has been reinventing itself constantly to explore the infinite possibilities of engineering and technology – an academy that inspires everyone to think differently. It is now the preferred career destination for meritorious students due to its academic integrity and standard as well as its attractive campus placement.

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

text: Home About Contact Events Highlights Academics Departments Library moodle Alumni LogIn Departments Library moodle The Techfest at the Academy of Technology is an annual event that showcases innovation and creativity in various fields of technology. It features a range of activities including workshops, competitions, exhibitions, and lectures from industry experts. Students have the opportunity to display their projects, engage in hands-on learning, and network with professionals. This event aims to inspire and cultivate a passion for technology among attendees, fostering an environment of learning and collaboration. Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology is an annual gathering focused on gaming and e-sports. It features competitive gaming tournaments, casual gaming sessions, and interactive workshops. Participants can compete in popular games, learn about game development, and connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts. The event aims to promote the gaming culture within the academy, encouraging both fun and educational experiences in the world of video games. The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology is a prestigious gathering that highlights the contributions of women in the field of space engineering. Esteemed IIT professors and renowned female scientists from ISRO come together to share their experiences, insights, and advancements in space technology. The event includes inspiring talks, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, aiming to encourage and empower female students to pursue careers in space engineering and related fields. The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology is a monthly gathering hosted by the Google Developer Group. It features tech talks, coding sessions, and networking opportunities for developers to share knowledge and collaborate on projects. sections.heading: The Techfest at the Academy of Technology
sections.text: The Techfest at the Academy of Technology is an annual event that showcases innovation and creativity in various fields of technology. It features a range of activities including workshops, competitions, exhibitions, and lectures from industry experts. Students have the opportunity to display their projects, engage in hands-on learning, and network with professionals. This event aims to inspire and cultivate a passion for technology among attendees, fostering an environment of learning and collaboration.

sections.heading: Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology
sections.text: Gamesmeet at the Academy of Technology is an annual gathering focused on gaming and e-sports. It features competitive gaming tournaments, casual gaming sessions, and interactive workshops. Participants can compete in popular games, learn about game development, and connect with fellow gaming enthusiasts. The event aims to promote the gaming culture within the academy, encouraging both fun and educational experiences in the world of video games.

sections.heading: The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology
sections.text: The 'Women in Space Engineering' event at the Academy of Technology is a prestigious gathering that highlights the contributions of women in the field of space engineering. Esteemed IIT professors and renowned female scientists from ISRO come together to share their experiences, insights, and advancements in space technology. The event includes inspiring talks, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, aiming to encourage and empower female students to pursue careers in space engineering and related fields.

sections.heading: The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology
sections.text: The GDG September Meet at the Academy of Technology is a monthly gathering hosted by the Google Developer Group. It features tech talks, coding sessions, and networking opportunities for developers to share knowledge and collaborate on projects.

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

Academic Programmes:
4 yrs B. Tech programme in Electronics & Communication Engineering.

HOD: Dr. Abhijit Banerjee.
Contact Mail Id: hod_ece@aot.edu.in

Overview of Departmental Infrastructure
Class / Tutorial Rooms/ Seminar Rooms.
HOD’s Room & Departmental Office.
Faculty Rooms.
Amenities Area.

Departmental Laboratories (with major experimental facilities & equipment)
1) COMMUNICATION ENGG. LABORATORY
AM,FM,PAM,DSB-SC kit (Modulation and Demodulation),VCO Kit (MODEL-VC01) and PLL Kit ( Model-A003),ASK,FSK,PSK,PCM kit(Modulation and Demodulation),Pseudo noise generator(PNS) , Manchester Coding and Decoding Kit , Function Generator Model-ST 4061(10MHz) , DSO Model-ST 401(50MHz), Spectrum Analyser(9kHz-1.5GHz).

2) D.S.P. LABORATORY
TMS 3205416C DSP Processor with microphones & Speakers,Open source software: GNU Octave, Scilab, Sage,Fourier Synthesis Trainer (Scientech), Sampling and Reconstruction Trainer (Scientech),Function generator (20Hz-2MHz- FG-01), (Scientech 4061, 10MHz-FPG, 40MHz-FC), DSO (40MHz- Caddo).

3) ELECTROMAGNETIC LABRATORY
Manual Antenna and Motorized Antenna Trainer (Simple Dipole Antenna, Folded Dipole Antenna, Yagi antenna, Log periodic antenna & etc.),Transmission line Trainer Kit, Horn Antenna Test Bench,Microwave Test Bench, GUNN Oscillator XG-11,Klystron Tube with mount (Indian) XM- 251,Spectrum Analyser (9kHz-1.5GHz), 2 Channel DSO 10 MHz (Scientech 401), Microcontroller Based Function Pulse Generator With 40MHz Frequency Counter (Scientech 4061).

4) ELECTRONICS ENGG. LABORATORY
Solar Cell(SA -130) and SCR Trainer Kit (SA-401),Zener DiodeTransistor, Rectifier, JFET,MOSFET Trainer kit,,R-C couple Amplifier (TA-05) , Multiple DC Power Supply 0-30V, 1A ( Scientech 4074),Function Generator(ST 4063(10MHz)),CRO (Caddo) (920R (25MHz)).

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

Departmental Laboratories (with major experimental facilities & equipment)
CONTROL SYSTEM LABORATORY:
DC Position Control Motor AC Servo Motor, Digital Control System Relay Control System PID Controller, Temperature Control System,P-IV computers(18 nos),Dual core computers(7nos),20 MHz CRO.

ELECTRICAL DESIGN AND SIMULATION LABORATORY:
Pulse generators, Power supply, Clock pulse generator, Digital multimeters.

ELECTRICAL ENGG AND CIRCUITS LABORATORY:
P-IV Computers (5 Nos), Dual core Computers (10 Nos), 20 MHz CROs, Digital Multimeters, 25 MHz DSOs, Function Generator, Mili-Voltmeters.

ELECTRICAL MACHINE LABORATORY:
Induction Motor DC Series Motor (Crompton-Parkinson) DC Shunt Motor (Crompton-Parkinson) ,DC Separately Excited Generator,DC Compound Generator, 1Φ Transformer,Alternator,Synchronous Motor,3ΦSlip Ring Induction Motor,,1Φ Induction Motor,Induction Generator.

ELECTRICAL SCIENCE LABORATORY:
DC Shunt Motor, DC Shunt Generator, 1 φ Transformers, Trainer Kit for Superposition Theorem ,Thevenin’s Theorem, Seperately excited DC Motor,3 phase Induction Motor,Trainer kit for series R-L-C circuit.

POWER ELECTRONICS AND DRIVES LABORATORY:
HP P-IV Computers , Control Circuit TRIAC and DIAC SCR. UJT Control Triggering Circuits, AC voltage controller, 20MHz CROs, 30 MHz CROs, 25 MHz DSO, 8 No.s 0.5 hp separately excited DC motor, 4 squirrel cage Induction motor, 1 No. 1hp single phase Induction .

POWER SYSTEM LABORATORY:
Alternator Power Circle Diagram P-IV Workstations, Insulators of different types ETAP Software, Transmission line simulator for determination of A, B, C, D parameters; High volatge testing kit for testing of insulators; Over current, Earth fault and under voltage relays.

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended. (if available) viii. Respective category certificate. (SC/ ST/ OBC etc.) as per sections 7.0 and 8.0 of Information Bulletin. (if applicable) ix. Aadhar Card of student. x. Domicile certificate as per section 6.0, 6.1 and 6.2 of Information Bulletin. 3. Three copies of stamp size and two copies of passport size colour photograph. Please note: The admission fees and all the documents above as applicable must be with the reporting candidate in order to complete the admission process. Physical reporting without fees and requisite documents will not be considered valid. Documents verification for MCA Counselling 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Timings: 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) Documents required: as prescribed in West Bengal Joint Entrance Examinations Board notification

Year of Establishment -July 2009
Academic Programme: 4 yrs B.Tech. programme in Mechanical Engineering

HOD: Prof. Niloy Ghosh
Contact Mail Id: hod_me@ aot.edu.in

Overview of Departmental Infrastructure
Class / Tutorial Rooms/ Seminar Rooms.
HOD’s Room & Departmental Office.
Faculty Rooms.
Amenities Area.

Departmental Laboratories (with major experimental facilities & equipment)
1) CAD LABORATORY:
42 HP work stations. FreeCAD software, AutoCAD software.

2) CNC LABORATORY:
CNC Vertical Machining Centre (BFW Industrial Type).

3) MACHINE DRAWING AND DESIGN LABORATORY:
Conventional Drafting Facility. QCAD, LibreCAD.

4) MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING LABORATORY:
Surface Grinder (COSMOS), HMT Lathe , Milling, Drilling, Shaping Machine. Forging tools, moulding apparatus with furnaces, welding setups, metrology and measurement equipments, Dynamometer (3D-Strain Gauge Type), Toolmaker’s Microscope.

5) MECHANICAL DESIGN AND SIMULATION LABORATORY:
Vibration, Balancing & CAM Apparatus, Metallurgical Microscope, Fatigue testing apparatus. FRAME 3DD & SALOME software (structural analysis), GNU Octave, Python.

6) MECHANICAL ENGINEERING LABORATORY:
UTM, Impact & Torsion Testing Machine, Hardness Tester, Apparatus for Flow measurement, Pipe Friction, Rotodynamics, Thermal experiment apparatus.
OpenFOAM (CFD).

7) MECHANICAL SCIENCE LABORATORY:
6 Centre Lathes and Tools for Product manufacturing.

        and measurement equipments, Dynamometer (3D-Strain Gauge Type), Toolmaker’s Microscope.</span>
</p>

text: ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY Physical Reporting for MCA Admission 2023 after 2nd round @ AOT Candidates allotted a seat in MCA at Academy of Technology and seeking ‘Admission’ must physically report to the campus from 10th October to 13th October, 2023 (11 AM to 4 PM) with the following: 1. The remaining admission fees, that is, Rs. 60,000/- (as per structure provided in https://aot.edu.in/mca-fees-structure/ excluding the Rs. 5000/- already paid to WBJEEB for first enrolment). The fees may be paid in cash or demand draft in favour of ACADEMY OF TECHNOLOGY, payable at Kolkata. 2. All required documents – original for verification and two self-attested copies for submission: i. Admit card of JECA 2023 Examination. ii. Provisional Admission Letter downloaded from WBJEEB counselling portal: www.wbjeeb.nic.in iii. Rank Card of JECA 2023 Examination. iv. 10th admit card/ certificate of respective Board as proof of age. v. 10th & 12th mark sheets. vi. Graduation level final semester mark sheet. (if Hard copy is not available net copy should be attested by the Head of the Institute last attended) vii. College leaving/character certificate from the Head of the Institute last attended.
